method: Engineering estimate by weighted scope and complexity; completion scores are explicit technical judgement, not hours or formal acceptance

blocks.name: Flujos de denuncias y derechos por finalidad, verificación y autoridad
Sesiones, cachés, colas, logs y recursos externos

limits: Weights are a planning baseline, not measured effort
Completion scores are estimates grounded in docs83/17 and current delivered/workspace evidence
No production readiness claim; external providers/legal gates remain separately pending
Do not increase percentage from test count alone; update block scores only with scope/evidence change
v2 keeps every v1 weight and changes two completion judgements from delivered scope; no inference from test counts or measured hours.
v3 keeps all weights and increases only the delivered workflow judgement; pending operational coverage, retention, communications and integral acceptance are unchanged.
